lines.en: label bathhouse35p2:
scene iocollapse1
It appears that tonight will be a night of collapses.
lines.zh: 看来今晚会是一个崩溃之夜。

lines.en: It started with me- overstaying my welcome in a welcoming place until {b}something else{/b} came and forced my head underwater.
lines.zh: 它从我开始的——在一个欢迎我的地方待得太久，直到{b}别的什么东西{/b}来了，把我的头按进了水里。

lines.en: If it weren’t for Io’s inherent need to remain burrowed into my scales in order to function, I’d probably be a lot worse off than I am right now.
lines.zh: 如果不是 Io 天生需要钻进我的鳞片里才能正常运转，我现在的处境大概会糟得多。

lines.en: I repeatedly thank her inside of my head, doing my best to not curse her in the process as I’m often unsure of whether or not staying here is good for me after all.
lines.zh: 我在心里一遍遍谢她，同时尽量不去诅咒她——因为我常常拿不准，留在这里对我来说究竟是好是坏。

lines.en: We’re at a point now where I often contemplate disappearing again for the sole purpose of making everyone else’s lives easier.
lines.zh: 现在已经到了这种地步：我经常考虑再次消失，唯一的目的就是让别人的日子好过一点。

lines.en: Unfortunately, there are reasons for me to stay here. Which allows me to circle back to my incessant, half-hearted gratefulness and remind you that this is a night of collapses.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我还有留下的理由。这让我绕回那种没完没了、半心半意的感激，并再次提醒你：这是个崩溃之夜。

lines.en: Uta was the next to collapse- and she’s currently tucked into the same bed I was asleep in just minutes ago. But the reason for her departure from the conscious world was a lot more cut and dry.
lines.zh: 下一个崩溃的是 Uta——她现在正裹在我几分钟前睡过的那张床上。不过她告别清醒世界的原因要直白得多。

lines.en: Unless my penis reminded her of something she’d rather not see, that is.
lines.zh: 除非我的鸡巴让她想起了什么她不想看到的东西。

lines.en: But based on the hue of her cheeks and the smile plastered to her face even now, I don’t think that’s the case.
lines.zh: 不过从她脸颊的颜色、还有到现在都挂在脸上的笑容来看，我觉得不是那么回事。

lines.en: Io will be the last to fall — though, it’s difficult for me to say that when she’d likely have you know she started tonight from the ground already.
lines.zh: Io 会是最后一个倒下的——不过这话我说不太准，因为她大概会让你知道，今晚她一开始就已经趴在地上了。

lines.en: She’s been trying to regain her footing since I’ve met her, and I’ve done nothing but kick her in the kneecaps as she tries to get up.
lines.zh: 从认识她起，她就一直在试着重新站稳，而我在她每次想爬起来的时候，除了往她膝盖上踹一脚什么都没做。

lines.en: But...in a sense, she’s been kneecapping herself as well.
lines.zh: 不过……从某种意义上说，她也在踹自己的膝盖。

lines.en: In looking at the pull switch with the tennis ball grip, I recount the things she's done, both right and wrong, and prop up imaginary fingers on imaginary hands in order to keep track of them.
lines.zh: 看着那个网球握柄的拉线开关，我一一数着她做过的事，对的错的都有，并在想象中的手上竖起想象中的手指来记账。

lines.en: The one with all her issues is packed before I know it- so I add even more fingers to the invisible hand.
lines.zh: 不知不觉，写满她那些毛病的那只手就满了-于是我又往那只无形的手上加了更多手指。

lines.en: I add...and add...and add until it’s no longer a hand at all, but a hideous abomination that only someone like her, who sees ugliness in beauty and beauty in ugliness, could ever grow to love.
lines.zh: 我加啊……加啊……一直加到它根本不再是手，而成了一个可怕的怪物——只有像她那样，能在美中看见丑、在丑中看见美的人，才可能慢慢爱上它。

lines.en: Maybe that’s why she’s fallen so hard for me.
lines.zh: 也许这就是她对我陷得这么深的原因。

lines.en: Maybe that’s one more reason she’d have you know she started off this night collapsed already.
lines.zh: 也许这也是她想让你知道的、又一个理由：今晚她是从崩溃状态开始的。

lines.en: I feel young again.
lines.zh: 我感觉自己又年轻了。

lines.en: But I also feel as if I’m not meant to be here.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得自己本不该在这里。

lines.en: : Uta will be fine in a few minutes, Sensei. Just need to wait for the cock shock to wear off.
lines.zh: : Uta 过几分钟就没事了，Sensei。只要等鸡巴冲击消退就行。

lines.en: : I’m a little offended you don’t react the same way. Seeing how calm you are around it is mildly off-putting.
lines.zh: : 你没同样的反应，我有点受伤。看你对着它这么淡定，多少让人有点不爽。

lines.en: : Need I remind you that I’ve been doing this since before all the men disappeared? I’ve seen my fair share of penises and have built up a bit of an immunity as the days have gone by, good sir.
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你吗，早在所有男人消失之前我就在干这行了？我见过的鸡巴够多了，日子久了也培养出了一点免疫力，先生。

lines.en: : Yours is totally the biggest though. So I don’t blame Uta one bit for fainting.
lines.zh: : 不过你的绝对是最大的。所以 Uta 晕过去我一点都不怪她。

lines.en: : I’m just going to say thank you and leave it at that so I don’t perv out on you any more than I already have tonight.
lines.zh: : 我就说声谢谢，到此为止吧，免得今晚在你面前再露出更多变态的样子。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}hate{/i} the fact that you do that, you know. And I definitely don’t want it to seem like I’m trying to change you or anything.
lines.zh: : 你知道，我并不{i}讨厌{/i}你这样。而且我绝对不想让你觉得我在试图改变你什么的。

lines.en: : Sure. You just {i}want{/i} me to change, right?
lines.zh: : 当然。你只是{i}想{/i}让我改变，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. And that’s totally different from changing you myself.
lines.zh: : 对。那和我亲手改变你可完全是两回事。

lines.en: : I’m sure that goes both ways though, right? Like, there’s no way you’d accept all of me the way I am now. If you did, you’d be an idiot.
lines.zh: : 不过我肯定这是双向的，对吧？比如你不可能接受我现在这个样子的全部。要是你接受了，那你就是个傻子。

lines.en: : Well, you’re right about that. You have more flaws than I can fit onto one invisible, mutated hand.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这点你说对了。你的毛病多到我一只隐形变异的手都装不下。

lines.en: : An invisible mutated what now?
lines.zh: : 隐形变异的什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. The point is that both of us suck and that we’ll probably continue sucking for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 别管这个。重点是，我们俩都很差劲，而且大概会一辈子继续差劲下去。

lines.en: : True that. But we can suck together and that’ll make it okay.
lines.zh: : 说得对。不过我们可以一起差劲，那样就没关系了。

lines.en: : It’s better to wear your flaws like decorative patches than to keep them tucked in your pockets after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，把缺点像装饰补丁一样戴在外面，总比把它们塞在口袋里强。

lines.en: : Because at least {i}we{/i} know who each other really are.
lines.zh: : 因为至少{i}我们{/i}知道彼此真正的样子。

lines.en: : Do we?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : We know enough.
lines.zh: : 我们知道的够多了。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: There’s only so much room on one jacket for...patches and stuff. And if you’ve got deep pockets, then...there’s no harm in-
lines.zh: : 一件夹克上能放……补丁什么的，位置就那么多。要是你的口袋够深，那……也没什么坏处-

lines.en: : Can we do away with the clothing metaphor while I’m still freshly wounded by the outfit I was wearing just a minute ago?
lines.zh: : 我刚被一分钟前穿的那身衣服伤得体无完肤，能不能别再用服装比喻了？

lines.en: : Yes, thank god. I was about to back myself into a corner and had no idea how I was going to get out of it.
lines.zh: : 行，谢天谢地。我正要把自己逼进死角，根本不知道怎么收场。

lines.en: : Seems par for the course nowadays. You look that way every single time you step into the classroom.
lines.zh: : 现在看来这也是常态了。你每次踏进教室都是那副样子。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have a handful of places you’d rather not be as well.
lines.zh: : 我肯定你也有好几个不想待的地方。

lines.en: : Well...you’re definitely right about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这点你绝对说对了。

lines.en: : You wanna talk about it? Or you wanna ignore this part of the conversation and move onto something that makes it seem like we suck a little bit less?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？还是想跳过这段对话，聊点让我们显得没那么差劲的东西？

lines.en: : I never really want to talk about anything, to be honest. Which is extremely annoying because I keep {i}doing just that{/i} lately.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我从来都不想聊什么。这特别烦人，因为我最近一直{i}在做这种事{/i}。

lines.en: : And the worst part is that I’m not even trying to. It’s just happening.
lines.zh: : 最糟的是，我甚至没刻意去做。它就那么发生了。

lines.en: : Well...there’s only so much room on one jacket.
lines.zh: : 嗯……一件夹克上的位置就那么多。

lines.en: : I thought we were done with clothing metaphors?
lines.zh: : 我以为我们已经不用服装比喻了？

lines.en: : Me too, but I couldn’t think of anything better other than a bottle and that’s just way too cliche.
lines.zh: : 我也这么想，可除了瓶子我想不出更好的，而那个又太老套了。

lines.en: : The usage was a little different this time, though. In fact, I like this new one way more than the flaws one. There really is only so much room on one jacket, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过这次用法不太一样。说实话，比起缺点那个，我更喜欢这个新的。一件夹克上的位置真的就那么多，Sensei。

lines.en: : You can decorate it with a million things that make it look nicer and more colorful...
lines.zh: : 你可以用上百万样东西装饰它，让它看起来更漂亮、更花哨……

lines.en: : But after a while, it’ll be hard to tell what any of it means at all. All those patches will start overlapping and you’ll lose any chance you have of ever blending into the background.
lines.zh: : 可过一阵子，就很难说清它们到底意味着什么了。那些补丁会开始互相重叠，你也就彻底失去了融入背景的可能。

lines.en: : Is that still what you’re trying to do in school?
lines.zh: : 你在学校里还在试着做这件事吗？

lines.en: : That’s what I’m trying to do everywhere.
lines.zh: : 我在哪里都在试着做这件事。

lines.en: : And it makes trying to stand out at the same time really hard. Those two things kind of contradict one another, you see.
lines.zh: : 而这也让“同时想出风头”变得特别难。你看，这两件事多少是互相矛盾的。

lines.en: : We can’t have everything. No one can.
lines.zh: : 我们不可能什么都有。谁都不行。

lines.en: : Too many patches, not enough jacket.
lines.zh: : 补丁太多，夹克不够。

lines.en: scene iocollapse2
: Crap. I think I might be the next one to pass out.
lines.zh: : 糟了。我觉得我可能是下一个晕过去的。

lines.en: : You can fall asleep if you want. I’ll stay here until...either one of you comes back to life.
lines.zh: : 想睡就睡吧。我会在这儿待着，直到……你们俩有谁醒过来。

lines.en: : I think I can hold out for a little longer. If I fall asleep, I’ll miss out on {i}this.{/i} And I’ll be damned if I don’t savor this shoulder for every second I can.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还能再撑一会儿。要是睡着了，我就会错过{i}现在{/i}。我可得好好品味这个肩膀的每一秒，绝不放过。

lines.en: : I’m just glad that’s all it takes to make you happy when everyone else always seems to want more.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴，在别人似乎总想要更多的时候，能让你开心的就只有这么多。

lines.en: scene iocollapse3
: Careful. You’re about to open up. And you were {i}just{/i} talking about how you hate that you keep doing that lately.
lines.zh: : 小心。你就要敞开心扉了。而你{i}刚刚{/i}还在说你有多讨厌自己最近老是这样。

lines.en: : That’s not what I was trying to do, Io.
lines.zh: : 我不是想那样，Io。

lines.en: : Well, what were you trying exactly? Because the untrained observer might interpret that “everyone always wants more” as a bit of narcissism or braggadocio leaking through.
lines.zh: : 那你到底想做什么？因为没受过训练的旁观者，可能会把那句“别人总想要更多”理解成一点点自恋或吹牛在往外冒。

lines.en: : Good word.
lines.zh: : 用词不错。

lines.en: : I don’t just show up to class because I {i}have{/i} to, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道，我去上课不是因为我{i}必须{/i}去。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}have{/i} to show up to class at all.
lines.zh: : 你根本{i}没有{/i}非去上课的理由。

lines.en: : True. But I actually kind of like learning. Well, some things at least.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过我其实有点喜欢学习。好吧，至少有些东西是。

lines.en: : Or...at least the {i}idea{/i} of learning, I guess...You know, since you always seem more focused on flirting with all your fake girlfriends than {i}molding our minds.{/i}
lines.zh: : 或者……至少是{i}学习{/i}这个概念吧，我想……你知道，因为你看起来总是更热衷于和那些假女朋友调情，而不是{i}塑造我们的心灵{/i}。

lines.en: : If I were to try and {i}mold{/i} any of your minds, I’d most likely just turn them into gross, unrecognizable lumps of clay.
lines.zh: : 要是我真去{i}塑造{/i}你们任何一个的心灵，大概只会把它们变成一团恶心、认不出来的黏土。

lines.en: : He says, completely unaware that a gross lump of clay is currently resting its weird clay head upon his shoulder.
lines.zh: : 他说这话的时候，完全没意识到有一团恶心的黏土正把它那颗奇怪的黏土脑袋靠在他肩膀上。

lines.en: : All I meant was that it’s...nice you’re content with just {i}this{/i} sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我的意思只是……有时候你能满足于{i}这样{/i}，挺好的。

lines.en: : It’s...a bit of a reprieve.
lines.zh: : 这……算是一种喘息。

lines.en: scene iocollapse4
: You...
: Fuck. I’m about to ruin things.
lines.zh: : 操。我就要把事情搞砸了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to lie to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你不用对我撒谎，Sensei。

lines.en: : I know you abhor the person I am and the things I want...or, in some cases...{i}don’t{/i} want.
lines.zh: : 我知道你厌恶我这个人，还有我想要的东西……或者在某些情况下……我{i}不{/i}想要的东西。

lines.en: scene iocollapse5
: I know that’s how I made it sound earlier, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道我刚才听起来是那个意思，不过-

lines.en: : It wasn’t {i}just{/i} earlier. It’s all the time.
lines.zh: : 不只是{i}刚才{/i}。一直都是。

lines.en: : You’ve been trying to take things further with me for like, {i}forever.{/i} And I’ve done nothing but shoot you down. So to hear you say you’re {i}glad{/i} that I’m like this now is...{i}kind of{/i} a slap in the face.
lines.zh: : 你从前就一直想跟我更进一步，都{i}多久了{/i}。而我除了拒绝什么都没做。所以听到你说你{i}很高兴{/i}我现在是这副样子，{i}多少{/i}像是一记耳光。

lines.en: : It’s like...all that anguish I felt for not being who you want me to be was totally pointless. So just tell it to me straight instead of pretending like you’ve been okay with me this whole time.
lines.zh: : 就好像……我因为没能成为你想要的样子而受的那些折磨全白费了。所以你干脆直说吧，别装作你一直都能接受我。

lines.en: scene iocollapse6
: Knew it. Everything is ruined. Fucking Io. You did it again.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。一切都毁了。操蛋的 Io。你又来了。

lines.en: : Nothing’s ruined, I...
lines.zh: : 什么都没毁，我……

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} been pushy with you. I know that.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}对你步步紧逼过。这点我知道。

lines.en: : But the reason for it has nothing to do with me not accepting who you are or...{i}disliking{/i} you or anything like that. I think those parts of you are fine, just...a little confusing.
lines.zh: : 但那跟我不接受你这个人、或者……{i}不喜欢{/i}你之类的毫无关系。我觉得你那些部分都没问题，只是……有点让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : I’m...not really good when it comes to connecting {i}without{/i} relying on the...physical aspect of a relationship to bridge the gap between myself and...whoever else.
lines.zh: : 我……不太擅长在{i}不{/i}依靠关系中那方面……也就是身体层面来搭桥、填补我和……别人之间鸿沟的情况下，与人建立连接。

lines.en: : I can help you build that bridge, you know. You don’t have to do it alone.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你搭那座桥，你知道的。你不用一个人来。

lines.en: : I know. But, like I said...that’s not really an area of expertise for me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。不过就像我说的……那真不是我的专长。

lines.en: : So I probably just tried to take the easy route and lure you into having sex with me so I could...fall back on that instead.
lines.zh: : 所以我大概只是想走捷径，引诱你和我上床，好让我……退回到那个上面去。

lines.en: : Gotcha.
lines.zh: : Gotcha。

lines.en: : I get it now.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : That’s a little different from what I thought was going on...but I’m really glad you told me since what you said is {i}way{/i} better than you only hanging around for the, uhh...{i}potential benefits.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这跟我想的不太一样……不过我真的很高兴你告诉了我，因为你说的{i}远比{/i}你只是冲着那些，呃……{i}潜在好处{/i}才留在我身边要好。

lines.en: : The truth is, and there’s probably no need for me to actually {i}say{/i} this when I’ve already made it pretty obvious, but...
lines.zh: : 事实是-我大概其实没必要真的{i}说{/i}出来，毕竟我已经表现得很明显了，不过……

lines.en: : I don’t really look at that kind of stuff the way everyone else does.
lines.zh: : 我看那种事的眼光和别人不太一样。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s necessary for a functional relationship at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它对一段能运转的关系来说根本不是必需的。

lines.en: : I think that the only reason people make such a big deal of it is because it’s portrayed in movies and TV as this huge, important concept when, in all actuality...it’s kind of repulsive.
lines.zh: : 我觉得人们把它看得那么重，唯一的原因是电影和电视把它描绘成了一个巨大而重要的概念，可实际上……它有点让人反感。

lines.en: : We’re taught when we’re younger that we’re only supposed to do that kind of stuff with people we love. Then the second we get older, it’s no longer about loving anyone at all — just “feeling good” or something.
lines.zh: : 我们小的时候被教导，那种事只能和爱的人做。可等我们一长大，它就再也不关爱谁的事了-只剩下“感觉好”什么的。

lines.en: : But what if it doesn’t feel good? What if one person’s idea of pleasure is another’s nightmare brought to life?
lines.zh: : 可要是它感觉并不好呢？要是一个人的快乐，正是另一个人成真的噩梦呢？

lines.en: : The idea of letting someone inside of {i}my{/i} body makes me so fucking sick at this point that it’s borderline impossible to even speak about sometimes.
lines.zh: : 一想到要让谁进入{i}我的{/i}身体，我就恶心得要命，有时候甚至连说出来都几乎不可能。

lines.en: : If you wanna get even more real, it’s taking all I have to not vomit right now.
lines.zh: : 要是你想听更真的话，我现在正用尽全力才没吐出来。

lines.en: : Then stop.
lines.zh: : 那就别说了。

lines.en: : Are you sure?...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？……

lines.en: : We were just about to reach the climax.
lines.zh: : 我们眼看就要到高潮了。

lines.en: : Pun not intended.
lines.zh: : 不是故意玩梗。

lines.en: : I don’t want you doing anything you’re not comfortable with...And if this is a topic that makes you feel sick, we can stay away from it.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你做任何不舒服的事……要是这个话题让你恶心，我们就避开它。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei……

lines.en: : I get that it’s probably disheartening to hear that I’m {i}this{/i} against sleeping with you...but that’s just something I can’t imagine myself budging on any time soon.
lines.zh: : 我知道，听到我{i}这么{/i}抗拒和你上床，你大概会很沮丧……可这是我在短期内想都不会想让步的事。

lines.en: : I’m a special case. I should have held up a big warning sign when we first met or something. “Hi, I’m Io. Please don’t touch me.” Something like that.
lines.zh: : 我是个特例。我们刚认识那会儿，我真该举一块大警示牌什么的。“你好，我是 Io。请不要碰我。”之类的。

lines.en: : It’s just one kind of touching, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那只是一种触碰而已。

lines.en: : That’s right. It’s just one kind of touching.
lines.zh: : 没错。只是一种触碰。

lines.en: : You can hold my hand whenever you want. You can hug me whenever you want. You can even {i}kiss{/i} me if the thought of that doesn't repulse you for some strange reason.
lines.zh: : 你想牵我的手随时都行。你想抱我随时都行。你甚至可以{i}亲{/i}我-要是你不会因为什么奇怪的理由觉得恶心的话。

lines.en: : Just...anything more than that is...
lines.zh: : 只是……比那再多一点就……

lines.en: : I can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: : I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to apologize for.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的。

lines.en: : There is, though.
lines.zh: : 有的。

lines.en: : I get that I’m an outlier and that...given your apparent libido, I’m pretty much the worst possible match for you on a physical level.
lines.zh: : 我知道我是个异类，而且……考虑到你那显而易见的性欲，在身体层面上我大概是你最不合适的配对。

lines.en: : But I get that you have “needs” and stuff, so...
lines.zh: : 但我也明白你有“需求”什么的，所以……

lines.en: : If you were to ever make me your girlfriend, I wouldn’t be opposed to you...you know...
lines.zh: : 要是你真让我当你女朋友，我不会反对你……你知道的……

lines.en: : Doing that kind of stuff with other people...
lines.zh: : 和别人做那种事……

lines.en: scene iocollapse7
: What?...
: O-Obviously not with just anyone! It would need to be someone I’m okay with! Like Uta or...
lines.zh: : 当-当然不是随便什么人！必须是我能接受的人！比如 Uta 或者……

lines.en: : Actually, Uta is probably the only person right now I’d be cool with. Or...maybe Yuki too.
lines.zh: : 其实现在大概只有 Uta 我能接受。或者……也许 Yuki 也行。

lines.en: : Basically, it would have to be someone else I could be around every day. And instead of doing sexual stuff with {i}me,{/i} you could take care of all of that with the...other girl.
lines.zh: : 基本上，得是另一个我能天天见面的人。你不用和{i}我{/i}做那些事，可以拿去和……另一个女孩解决。

lines.en: : And we’d all share our time equally and...I guess for you it would be like having two or...one and a {i}half{/i} girlfriends since I can’t...you know...uhh...
lines.zh: : 然后我们平分彼此的时间……我想对你来说，差不多像是同时有两个、或者……一个{i}半{/i}女朋友，因为我不能……你知道的……呃……

lines.en: : This sounded a lot less insane when I pitched it to Uta, I swear.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，我跟 Uta 提这个的时候，听起来可没这么疯。

lines.en: scene iocollapse8
: You pitched this to Uta already?
lines.zh: : 你已经跟 Uta 提过这个了？

lines.en: : Yeaaaaah...but I don’t think it went very well.
lines.zh: : 是-啊……不过我觉得不太顺利。

lines.en: : Io...would you seriously be okay with a relationship like that? You wouldn’t feel left out at all?
lines.zh: : Io……你真的能接受那样的关系吗？你一点都不会觉得被冷落？

lines.en: scene iocollapse9
: Left out? Why would I feel left out? I already told you I don’t look at that kind of stuff the way other people do. And if it’s with someone else I love, I’d be totally okay with it.
lines.zh: : 被冷落？我为什么会觉得被冷落？我说过了，我看那种事的眼光和别人不一样。而且如果是和另一个我爱的人，我完全能接受。

lines.en: : The big thing for me is just knowing I’m wanted and needed and...that I have someone to share all of my shitty thoughts with.
lines.zh: : 对我来说最重要的，只是知道自己被需要、被想要，还有……有个人可以分享我所有那些糟糕的念头。

lines.en: : Whatever you and the other girl do to each other would be fine so long as it doesn’t come between all of us. I’d just stay out of that part.
lines.zh: : 你和那个女孩之间做什么都行，只要不介进我们所有人之间就行。那部分我就不掺和了。

lines.en: : But I’m sure you and I could find something to do on our own as well. Same thing with me and the girl who, again, would probably be Uta because I can’t imagine this sort of future with anyone else.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信你和我之间也能找到属于我们自己的事做。我和那个女孩之间也一样-再说一次，那个人大概会是 Uta，因为我想不出还能和别人一起构想这样的未来。

lines.en: : Again, I swear it sounded less crazy when I pitched it to her. I think I’m fucking things up right now.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我发誓跟她提的时候听起来没这么疯。我觉得我现在正在把事情搞砸。

lines.en: : No, I just...
lines.zh: : 不，我只是……

lines.en: : That’s not really...a proposal I was expecting from you given how...combative you’ve been in terms of me with literally any other girl.
lines.zh: : 这真不是……我会预期从你口中听到的提议，毕竟你一碰到我和别的任何女孩，态度都那么……好斗。

lines.en: : That’s because I don’t {i}like{/i} any of those girls. But if you were to hook up with Uta, I wouldn’t really mind at all.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我{i}不喜欢{/i}那些女孩里的任何一个。可要是你和 Uta 搞上了，我真的一点都不介意。

lines.en: : In fact, I’d be happy for you guys since you’re my two favorite people and, to be honest, you both have {i}way{/i} too much sexual energy that needs to be let out.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我会为你们高兴，因为你们是我最喜欢的人之二，而且说实话，你们俩的性欲都{i}太{/i}旺盛了，得发泄出来。

lines.en: : I’m just not sure if Uta sees you the same way I do. If she did, I’d be 100%% down to give this a shot.
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定 Uta 看你的眼光和我是不是一样。要是一样，我会 100%% 赞成试一试。

lines.en: : Like sure, it might have its issues at first, but what doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 当然，一开始可能会有这样那样的问题，可什么没有呢？

lines.en: : It’s the only way the two of us could ever be together without me completely rebuilding everything I am. And I might be great at building stuff, Sensei, but that is a task so daunting that even I wouldn’t touch it.
lines.zh: : 这是我们能在一起的唯一方式，除非我把自己的一切彻底重建。Sensei，我也许很擅长做东西，可那任务艰巨到连我都不想碰。

lines.en: : You really...can’t imagine a future where the two of us are together {i}without{/i} a second girl?
lines.zh: : 你真的……想不出一个我们俩在{i}没有{/i}第二个女孩的情况下在一起的未来？

lines.en: scene iocollapse10
: Not one I can realistically see happening at least...
lines.zh: : 至少我想不出一个现实可行的……
: Io……

lines.en: : I can’t give you what you want, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我给不了你想要的东西，Sensei。

lines.en: : All I can do is hold you over.
lines.zh: : 我能做的只是让你先撑一阵。

lines.en: scene black
: Nngh...what time is it?...
lines.zh: : 嗯啊……现在几点了？……

lines.en: : What happened to me?...
lines.zh: : 我这是怎么了？……

lines.en: : Morning, sleepyhead. You passed out after walking in on Sensei’s giant wang.
lines.zh: : 早上好，瞌睡虫。你撞见 Sensei 那根巨大的老二之后就晕过去了。

lines.en: : Oh...crap.
lines.zh: : 哦……糟了。

lines.en: : I was really hoping that was a dream.
lines.zh: : 我真希望那只是个梦。

lines.en: : He’s...not still here is-
lines.zh: : 他……该不会还在这儿-

lines.en: : Morning, Uta.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Uta。

lines.en: : Ah! H-Heeeeey, Sensei! Crazy meeting you here! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 啊！嗨-嗨——呀，Sensei！居然在这儿碰到你！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hey, uhh...I ran here all the way from the dorms, so if it seemed like I was passing out after seeing your-
lines.zh: : 嘿，呃……我一路从宿舍跑过来的，所以如果我看起来像是看到你的那话之后晕倒了-

lines.en: : Actually, wait. Starting over. I didn’t see anything at all! I was just really tired!
lines.zh: : 等等，重来。我什么都没看见！我只是真的很困！

lines.en: : So tired that...I’m going back to sleep! Goodnight!
lines.zh: : 困到……我要回去睡觉了！晚安！

lines.en: : Uta, no one is going to hold it against you for-
lines.zh: : Uta，没有人会因为你-而怪你的

lines.en: : Don’t hold it anywhere near me! That thing was the size of my leg and it wasn’t even hard yet!
lines.zh: : 别把它举到离我近的地方！那玩意儿跟我大腿一样大，而且它还没硬呢！

lines.en: : I thought you said you didn’t see it?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你说了没看见呢？

lines.en: : I thought I said goodnight!
lines.zh: : 我还以为我说了晚安呢！

lines.en: Uta wakes up and...promptly goes back to sleep before Io and I can put a definitive end to our conversation.
lines.zh: Uta 醒过来，然后……在 Io 和我能为这段对话画上句号之前，又立刻睡了回去。

lines.en: And while the final arc of our extremely uncomfortable and alarming discussion was the {i}one{/i} bit of salvation I had during tonight’s mandatory collapse-
lines.zh: 虽然我们这场极度不适又令人心惊的讨论的最后一段，是我在今晚这场被迫崩溃中仅有的一{i}点{/i}救赎-

lines.en: It didn’t pick me up at all.
lines.zh: 它一点也没让我振作起来。

lines.en: It left me wanting nothing more than to remain stuck here-
lines.zh: 它只让我别无所求，只想一直卡在这里-

lines.en: Glued to the floor-
lines.zh: 粘在地板上-

lines.en: And gazing into the deep blue eyes of a girl that I should not want, but do.
lines.zh: 凝视着那个我不该想要、却偏偏想要了的女孩的深蓝色眼睛。

lines.en: Thus one more name is added to the list of things I can not have.
lines.zh: 于是，又一个名字被加进了我无法拥有之物的清单。

lines.en: And it’s distressing in ways that nothing else has been.
lines.zh: 而它带来的痛苦，是别的东西从未有过的。

lines.en: I decide against wasting any more thoughts on it.
lines.zh: 我决定不再为它多费心思。

lines.en: I feel like doing so would just make me sick.
lines.zh: 我觉得再想下去只会让自己难受。
